saint.name: Saint Gregory the Great, Pope and Doctor of the Church
saint.blurb: St. Gregory the Great was a Roman aristocrat who gave up a political career to become a monk before being elected pope in 590, guiding Rome through plague, famine, and Lombard invasions while reorganizing Church lands to feed the poor. He sent Augustine of Canterbury to convert the English, wrote influential works like the Pastoral Rule and Moralia on Job, shaped Western liturgy (Gregorian chant bears his name), and is honored as one of the four great Doctors of the Latin Church.
